title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: search results match text inside images in Word and PowerPoint files
summary: Hold: the prose incorrectly rules out Restricted Content Discovery as a control over this search change, although Microsoft's documentation covers site content in organization-wide discovery and Copilot responses. The roadmap facts, admin path and PowerShell command are supported; licensing uncertainty should be narrowed to this particular enhancement.

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery is configured in SharePoint admin center at Sites > Active sites > site > Settings > Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: In the SharePoint admin center, expand Sites and select Active sites. Select the site you want to configure. Open the Settings tab, and then turn Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot on.

claims.claim: Set-SPOSite -Identity <site-url> -RestrictContentOrgWideSearch $true enables Restricted Content Discovery for a site.
claims.quote: Enable Restricted Content Discovery for a site ... Use PowerShell ... Set-SPOSite -Identity <site-url> -RestrictContentOrgWideSearch $true

claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery is a SharePoint site-level control.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery is a site-level setting. ... You can only apply this feature to SharePoint sites. It's not supported for OneDrive sites.
